title: Report to people
description: A delivery record of kind digest or proposal_digest. The table, numbers, catalog names and the set of cards are built by core code from the snapshot of views at the moment the task starts (snapshot_id); code chooses which cards go in. The model paragraph goes only as a separate marked part: plain text up to 800 characters, without links, mentions, markup, commands, or stop and approval ids; with untrusted_seen it does not go to a group chat, except for a binding with model_text: labeled (REP-2). What is hidden by mark is counted in hidden; what is hidden by permissions is not counted (REP-3, REP-7). The reporter draws no cards and makes no decisions (REP-6).

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot of views at the moment the task starts.

chat.description: Chat binding from the delivery address.

data_mark.description: Mark of the reporter task: not above the target ceiling and the initiator data:<class> (REP-3).

key.description: Row key from the message catalog.

values.description: Numbers, states, catalog names and reason codes.

kind.description: Kind of the card subject: a proposal or an approval.

cards.description: Cards that code chose; the channel draws them from the records (REP-6).

text.description: Optional model paragraph, only for the agent runtime.

untrusted_sources.description: Untrusted sources from a closed list: source kind, role or tool, without text.
